questions.question: When a منادى begins with الـ, what must be inserted between يَا and the noun?
options: أيُّها for masculine or أيَّتها for feminine as a separator
The لام of المفعول لأجله as a buffer
A second يَا attached directly to the ل of الـ
يَا is doubled for extra emphasis before الـ
questions.explanation: Because يَا cannot precede الـ directly, أيُّها (masc.) or أيَّتها (fem.) is inserted as an intermediary between the particle and the noun.

questions.question: How is a منادى مفرد معرفة — a non-مضاف called-upon noun — built in Arabic grammar?
options: مبني على الفتحة like a مضاف
منصوب, like all other categories of منادى
مبني على الكسرة in all cases
مبني على الضمة
questions.explanation: A منادى مفرد معرفة (non-مضاف, regardless of whether it is grammatically singular) is مبني على الضمة; it is the مضاف, شبه مضاف, and ناكرة types that are منصوب.

questions.question: What grammatical role does المفعول لأجله serve, and how is it marked?
options: It states the place of an action; منصوب with في implied
It states the manner of an action; مجرور with كـ implied
It states the reason for an action; منصوب with لام implied
It states the time of an action; منصوب with في implied
questions.explanation: المفعول لأجله answers 'why' an action was done and is منصوب with an implied لام, as in قَعَدْتُ جُبُنًا — I stayed back out of cowardice.

questions.question: الاشتغال refers to which grammatical construction?
options: Occupied-verb construction; a fronted noun governed by a dropped verb
A warning construction in which the verb is dropped obligatorily
The adverb of reason; منصوب with لام implied
Dropping the final letter(s) of a منادى for ease of pronunciation
questions.explanation: الاشتغال describes the construction in which a noun is fronted and the governing verb is dropped, leaving a later pronoun or verb 'occupied' with it.

questions.question: What does تَرْخِيم mean in the context of النداء?
options: Dropping the final letter(s) of a منادى for ease of pronunciation
The obligatory omission of the verb in a warning construction
A particle used to negate a prior false claim
An indefinite but specific addressee that takes مبني على الضمة
questions.explanation: تَرْخِيم is the trimming of a منادى's final letter(s) for ease; the resulting form takes either a ضمة or the noun's original vowel, e.g. يَا حَارُ or يَا حَارِ.

questions.question: What did the أُمِّيُّون among Banu Isra'eel possess in place of genuine Torah knowledge?
options: Personal scholarly judgments derived from their own reasoning
A simplified written summary of the Torah in their own language
Fabricated أَمَانِيّ fed to them by their corrupt rabbis
Direct oral instruction preserved from their prophets
questions.explanation: The أُمِّيُّون could not read or verify the Torah and so relied entirely on the wishful fabrications their rabbis invented for them, including the claim that the Fire would only touch them for a few days.

questions.question: What two simultaneous crimes did the corrupt scholars of Banu Isra'eel commit with the scripture?
options: Denying prophethood outright and abandoning congregational worship
Rejecting the مِيثَاق publicly and misguiding their children privately
تحريف الكتاب and withholding zakah from their communities
تحريف الكتاب and الكذب على الله, both for forbidden worldly gain
questions.explanation: They distorted the scripture with their own hands (تحريف الكتاب) and then attributed those fabrications to Allah (الكذب على الله), all in exchange for سُحْت — forbidden worldly gain.

questions.question: What is the fate of the person described as أَحَاطَتْ بِهِ خَطِيئَتُه?
options: His sins are forgiven after a limited period in the Fire
He is spared the Fire if he had a righteous lineage
He becomes a permanent resident of the Fire
He receives a lighter punishment due to surrounding ignorance
questions.explanation: When sin encircles a person from every side closing all paths of salvation, Ayah 81 establishes that such a person is a permanent resident of the Fire with no prospect of exit.

questions.question: What is the function of the particle بَلَى in Ayah 80?
options: It introduces a solemn binding covenant
It affirms an existing claim made by Banu Isra'eel
It negates the prior false claim and affirms the opposite truth
It expresses wishful thinking about a future outcome
questions.explanation: بَلَى is a particle that directly refutes what was asserted before it — here negating the claim that the Fire would only touch them a few days — and affirms the truth in its place.

questions.question: Which term means 'deliberate distortion of scripture'?
options: مِيثَاق
تَحْرِيف
أَمَانِيّ
سُحْت
questions.explanation: تَحْرِيف refers specifically to the deliberate alteration and distortion of revealed scripture, which the corrupt scholars performed with their own hands.

questions.question: Under the مسائل الاثنا عشر rule, when does the Sahibain opinion consider the salah valid rather than batil?
options: Whenever any of the twelve conditions arises at any point in the salah
When any of the twelve conditions arises after the tashahud sitting is complete
Only when the imam also corrects the situation before salam
Only when the entire salah has been completed without incident
questions.explanation: The operative Hanafi opinion (Sahibain) holds the salah valid if any of the twelve conditions arises after the tashahud sitting has been completed; before that point, the salah is batil by agreement.

questions.question: Under what circumstance does the obligation of ترتيب drop for a صاحب ترتيب in the Hanafi madhab?
options: When missed prayers exceed five, causing كثرة القضاء
When the person has been unconscious for more than three prayers
When the time of the current salah is about to expire
When the person is travelling and prayers must be shortened
questions.explanation: ترتيب — the sequential ordering of qada before the current salah — is wajib in the Hanafi madhab but drops once a person's missed prayers exceed five, a state called كثرة القضاء.

questions.question: How does the ruling at the three absolute prohibition times differ from the restriction that applies after Fajr and after Asr?
options: Both restrictions identically prohibit the same categories of salah
The absolute times ban only nawafil; post-Fajr and post-Asr ban all salah
The absolute times ban all salah; post-Fajr and post-Asr only ban nawafil
The absolute times ban only fard prayers; nawafil remain permitted at those times
questions.explanation: At sunrise, sunset, and the sun's exact zenith, no salah of any kind is permitted; after Fajr and after Asr the prohibition is narrower — only nawafil are banned, while qada prayers and salat al-janazah remain valid.

questions.question: Who is described by the term صاحب ترتيب?
options: One with more than five missed prayers for whom ترتيب has dropped
One who was unconscious for six or more prayers and is now excused
One who leads the congregation specifically in qada prayers
One with five or fewer missed prayers who must pray qada in order
questions.explanation: صاحب ترتيب designates a person whose missed prayers number five or fewer; such a person must pray those qada prayers in order before performing the current salah.

questions.question: What does الاستواء refer to in the context of prohibited salah times?
options: The period immediately after Fajr salah when nawafil are forbidden
The completion of the tashahud sitting that validates salah under the twelve conditions
The sun at its exact zenith; one of the three absolute prohibition times
The moment of sunset; one of the three absolute prohibition times
questions.explanation: الاستواء (also called الزوال) is the sun's brief pause at its exact zenith before beginning its descent, and it is one of the three absolute prohibition times during which no salah — fard, nafl, janazah, or sajda-e-tilawat — is permitted.
